description: This file contains LESS mixins for styling FontAwesome icons and related UI components. It defines reusable style blocks such as icon styling, border-radius, and icon stacking layouts.

methods.name: icon
methods.description: Mixin to style an icon element with a specified icon code.

methods.name: icon-FontAwesome
methods.description: Mixin to apply FontAwesome font styling.

methods.name: border-radius
methods.description: Mixin to apply border-radius with vendor prefixes.

methods.name: icon-stack
methods.description: Mixin to create a stacked icon layout with customizable size parameters.
